label: Model result (Linux simulator), not a measurement

policies.name: original_pushfps
policies.description: fixed 16 ms reorder wait (library default, TransportTuning::kLibraryReorderUs); audio 'today' rule, 20 ms reserve

policies.name: slipstream_rc4
policies.description: exp/rc4 with every switch unset: the same 16 ms wait and audio rule (nothing differs on this path in the model)

policies.name: slipstream_rc4_switches
policies.description: VEYRA_EXP_RP_LAN_PROFILE=1 (2 ms) + VEYRA_EXP_RP_REORDER_ADAPTIVE=1 (ReorderWindow.h, with the model's per-frame evidence) + VEYRA_EXP_RP_AUDIO_FAST_RECOVER=1

policies.name: smartlink_apply
policies.description: SmartLink apply on top of slipstream_rc4 (configured wait 16 ms), audio fast rule with SmartLink's target

policies.name: smartlink_apply_lan
policies.description: SmartLink apply with the LAN profile (configured wait 2 ms), audio fast rule with SmartLink's target

policies.name: smartlink_apply_learned
policies.description: as smartlink_apply_lan, stall risk from the learned comparison model

policies.name: early_loss_lan
policies.description: LAN profile 2 ms + 'early loss': a frame missing more units than its FEC units is given up at once while no out-of-order packet was seen for 300 s (Moonlight's speculative RFI idea, research doc C)

policies.name: early_loss_16
policies.description: the library's 16 ms wait + the same 'early loss' rule

scenarios.name: wired_rare_loss
scenarios.description: wired, 0.02 % of packets lost at random for 90 s

scenarios.name: rtt_variation
scenarios.description: 90 s: one-way delay wanders 0-48 ms (round trip ~3-100 ms), period 20 s, plus a 0-20 ms step every ~5 s

scenarios.name: wifi_random_spikes
scenarios.description: 90 s: droughts of 20-80 ms at random, mean gap 5 s; 0.3 % of packets 1-6 ms late

scenarios.name: wifi_periodic_spikes
scenarios.description: 90 s: droughts of 30-70 ms every 10 s (+-0.3 s), as background scans do

scenarios.name: governor_case
scenarios.description: 90 s: stalls of 20-80 ms every 2-8 s (uniform), mean jitter under 3 ms (the governor review's case)

scenarios.name: burst_loss
scenarios.description: 90 s: Gilbert-Elliott loss bursts, mean 5 packets, one every ~2.5 s; 3 FEC packets per frame

scenarios.name: congestion
scenarios.description: 90 s: every 20 s a 3 s bottleneck at 95 % of the stream's rate, 100 ms buffer (queue grows, then drains)

scenarios.name: bandwidth_drop
scenarios.description: 90 s: capacity 85 % of the stream (30 ms buffer); the console lowers its target to 75 % after 2 s

scenarios.name: interruptions
scenarios.description: outages of 0.2, 1 and 5 s at 40, 70 and 100 s

scenarios.name: weak_signal
scenarios.description: 90 s: signal falls 70 -> 25 %; droughts of 20-60 ms (mean gap 3 s) and 0.5 % random loss

scenarios.name: reordering_loss
scenarios.description: 90 s: 2 % of packets 1-12 ms late and 0.2 % lost at random
